QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Analyzing Attack Patterns
QuestInfo.1:
A giant monster is attacking the expedition in Moonbridge. They need to come up with a strategy if they're going to defeat it, but that means they need information. Observe the monster's attack patterns and report to #p3003564# to complete the Expedition mission.

#bThe giant monster's attack can be observed around Moonbridge from time to time. However, you should be cautious, since you will take damage if hit by an attack.#k
QuestInfo.2: You've analyzed the pattern of the monster's massive attacks and completed the Expedition mission.
